welcomePage.title: Fara aiki
welcomePage.intro: Barka da zuwa Leafen! Wannan shafi naku ne; za ku iya ajiye shi, canza shi ko share shi.
welcomePage.slash: Rubuta / a ko'ina don ƙara kanun kai, jeri, ayyukan da za a yi, tebura, hotuna da sauransu.
welcomePage.pages: Ƙara shafuka daga sandar gefe, kuma saka shafuka cikin wasu shafuka don kiyaye tsari.
welcomePage.databases: Ƙirƙiri tarin bayanai don bin diddigin ayyuka, shirye-shirye ko wani abu, kuma duba shi a matsayin tebur, allo ko kalanda.
welcomePage.together: Ku gayyaci mutane zuwa wurin aikinku kuma ku gyara shafuka tare a lokaci ɗaya.
welcomePage.agents: Haɗa Claude Code, Codex, ko manhajojin Claude da ChatGPT don su yi amfani da Leafen a matsayin ƙwaƙwalwar ku: sunan wurin aiki a sandar gefe → {{connectAgent}}

notionImportHandoff.link: Idan ba za ka so ka liƙa shi a nan ba, saka shi a cikin Leafen maimakon: a allon shigo da Leafen ({{url}}), saka shi a filin “{{field}}” kuma ka danna “{{save}}”. Leafen yana ajiye shi a ɓoye, kuma zan ci gaba da zarar ya shiga.
notionImportHandoff.rest: A ƙarshe, liƙa token ɗin a nan cikin tattaunawarmu: na miƙa shi ga Leafen, wanda yake ajiye shi a ɓoye, sannan na ci gaba. Wannan tattaunawa ma tana riƙe da shi, don haka idan an gama motsi, share wannan haɗin a Notion ko ka mai da shi sabon token.
